_readme: Candidate lunar targets (night Task 5, 14 Nov 2026). Reviewed 15 Nov 2026 (see 'review' per entry): verified = polar_sl2, polar_haworth and the 4 Mare targets; all others stay false. A person checks the preview (figures/moon/targets/) and flips verified per target and per criterion. Polar: src/compute_polar_candidates.py (one per Artemis III 2022 region, same method as Shackleton); Mare: src/compute_mare_candidates.py (per-mare split of config/lunar_targets.json mare.cells). Entries with skipped: true have no criteria (reason in skip_reason). Per-criterion shape as config/lunar_targets.json: value, source, date, verified (+ tolerance for Mare). Polar entries carry no tolerance: use config/pipeline.yaml polar tolerances. Report: docs/NEW_TARGETS_REPORT.md

review.why: Kept as the one de Gerlache target: still a candidate in NASA's 2024 update (9 regions, 'de Gerlache Rim 2'). Same bowl as polar_site11 (low points 45 m apart). Weakest bowl of the set: 1.3 km wide, 53 m spill depth, just above the 50 m minimum. PGDA labels Site11 and SL2 both 'de Gerlache rim', so the Rim 1/Rim 2 mapping is UNVERIFIED: say 'de Gerlache rim' on cards. The target is the one small crater the bowl detector found inside the 15 km region, not the region's defining feature (Artemis regions were picked for sunlit ridges/peaks): c1 < 1, i.e. this crater's rim is less sunlit than flat ground. Card wording: 'small crater in Artemis III region X'.

targets.label: Mare · Mare Tranquillitatis (5 cells)

c9_relief.source: SLDEM2015 (LOLA + SELENE Kaguya TC merge, 512 ppd = 59 m; Barker et al. 2016) windows from src/fetch_sldem_window.py, resampled to the 60 m grid; cells: config/mare_cells.json; per-mare split of config/lunar_targets.json mare.cells

c10_flat_base.source: SLDEM2015 (LOLA + SELENE Kaguya TC merge, 512 ppd = 59 m; Barker et al. 2016) windows from src/fetch_sldem_window.py, resampled to the 60 m grid; cells: config/mare_cells.json; per-mare split of config/lunar_targets.json mare.cells

c30_small_craters.tolerance_rule: max(IQR, mare_v11.c30_tolerance_floor 0.0127); display only, not used in a score
c30_small_craters.repro_note: base spot recomputed with mare_cell on the SLDEM2015 tile windows; c9/c10/c12/c13 differ slightly from the frozen per-cell values (repro_diff = now - frozen), see compute_mare_c30.py
c30_small_craters.unit: closed depressions per km2 (>= 10 m deep, >= 300 m wide, elongation <= 2) within 5 km of the base spot
c30_small_craters.source: SLDEM2015 windows (src/fetch_sldem_window.py) on the 60 m grid as compute_mare_target.py; pipeline.mare.small_crater_density via src/compute_mare_c30.py
c30_small_craters.check: computed by Claude Code, to be checked by Mateo
c30_small_craters.note: only 5 cells: the IQR is a rough spread estimate; under mare_v11.common_tolerance the 20-cell tolerance is used

targets.note: only 5 cells: the IQR of so few values is a rough spread estimate

review.why: Same 20 SLDEM2015 cells as config/lunar_targets.json mare (checked 14 Nov), split by mare; only 5 cells each, so the IQR is a rough spread estimate (tolerance = max(IQR, frozen floor)).
